messages:
Mira Patel: FYI triggered a follow-up thread from last night's paging noise. want to lock down handoff gaps and note any runbook clarifications before the postmortem.
Sam Ortiz: saw a spike in 02:10-02:30 UTC, paging storm correlated with cache evictions. did we have the fallback policy enabled?
Jordan Lee: fallback kicked in but routing to the secondary model failed for ~7m due to an old pin in the canary config. I removed the pin at 02:17 and traffic recovered.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2026-03-14T02:09Z - Page created: high-error-rate / text-generation (incident id: INC-2321) — Pager duty link: https://p.example/inc/INC-2321
Nadia Chen: customer impact: subset of small-transaction customers saw 5xx for ~8m, we have logs for 47 unique customer tokens. removing pin fixed the errors, but cost spike due to replays.
Mira Patel: thanks. main asks: 1) schedule postmortem, 2) track actions (runbook edits + config validation), 3) review on-call handoff notes (we had some ambiguity at 02:25).
Sam Ortiz: I can own the postmortem doc + timeline. proposing postmortem slot tomorrow 16:00 UTC — anyone blocked?
Priya Das: I can do 16:00. Jordan, can you present the mitigation timeline and root-cause?
Jordan Lee: yup. will prepare a 10m run-through and include the canary pin history. also will attach the rollout API call logs.
Nadia Chen: I'll pull the customer-impact table and sample request/responses and redact.
Mira Patel: action items I want tracked in the doc: - update runbook step for config pin detection + automatic validation - add a pre-handoff checklist to confirm ongoing canaries - add escalation contact for infra-config changes - add a small script to verify fallback routing after canary failures
Sam Ortiz: adding owners: runbook update -> Sam; pre-handoff checklist -> Mira; escalation contact -> Priya; fallback verification script -> Jordan. due dates?
Mira Patel: suggested due dates: runbook + checklist by EOW; script + escalation contact by next Wed.
Jordan Lee: technical note: the canary pin was introduced by an SDK rollout job that didn't set model_compat:true. that allowed a fallback mismatch. I can post the exact command:

```
# offending command (sanitized)
redwood rollout create --model v2.1 --pin=true --metadata '{"compat":false}'
```

Jordan Lee: we should expand the rollout API linting to warn on missing compat flag.
Sam Ortiz: Agreed. we can add a pre-commit lint in the infra repo and a CI job that rejects rollout requests missing compat.
Priya Das: for handoff ambiguity: oncall @02:20 mentioned "monitoring says healthy" while infra showed degraded instances. we need a concrete script in the handoff to run `redwood status --full` and paste the output.
Mira Patel: good point. handoff checklist item: paste `redwood status --full` + active canary IDs. also include top-5 erroring routes.
Nadia Chen: I'll create a small template message for the oncall handoff channel we can copy-paste. keeps things consistent and reduces ambiguity.
Jordan Lee: mitigation follow-up: we had a TTL mismatch in cache config causing mass invalidations when the replay job hit. separate but related. adding that to postmortem as contributing factor.
Sam Ortiz: Cost/control note: replay increased token spend by ~12% in the incident window. we should include a retro action for quota throttles on replays.
Mira Patel: recording decisions inline: - Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC - Owners assigned as above - Immediate runbook patch: add explicit canary-pin validation and handoff checklist template (Sam + Mira) - Implement rollout lint + CI check (Jordan + Infra) - Fallback verification script (Jordan) - Escalation contact update (Priya)
incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem doc in /docs/incidents/INC-2321 and tag with severity/impact.
Priya Das: will update the escalation rota after the postmortem. adding a contact alias for infra-config oncall.
Sam Ortiz: quick question — do we want an automated alert when a rollback or pin remove happens? could help detect silent mitigations.
Jordan Lee: we already emit audit events for rollout changes, but no alert rule. we can add a high-sensitivity rule for pin removals on production models.
Mira Patel: add that to the action list. also, check whether runbook language needs to include "if a pin remove occurs, call the customer escalation path" when customers affected.
Nadia Chen: scheduling follow-up: I'll create the postmortem doc now and pre-populate owners + evidence links. Sam, ping me if you want a skeleton.
Sam Ortiz: thanks — I'll grab the timeline and paste a concise incident timeline with times and who did what.
Priya Das: small UX note: handoff template should include a line "ongoing mitigations" and a TTL for next check-in (e.g., 15m). reduces confusion.
Mira Patel: agreed. add "next_check_in" to template.
Jordan Lee: final technical action: I'll add a unit test in the rollout service that rejects pins without compat flag and a monitoring metric for fallback failures.
Mira Patel: thanks all. let's close the loop after postmortem. I'll own verifying the runbook edits merged. :thumbsup:
Sam Ortiz: +1
Priya Das: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: NOTE: This thread will be archived after the postmortem doc is created and tagged.
